Fonts bundled in lib/swiftui-screenshot/fonts (all under the SIL Open Font License 1.1,
whose text follows this list). They stand in for Apple's system fonts. Each font's own
licence file, as published upstream, is in that directory as <Font>-LICENSE.txt.

  Inter (InterVariable*.ttf)
      Copyright (c) 2016 The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter)
  Nunito (Nunito[wght].ttf)
      Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito)
  Source Serif 4 (SourceSerif4*.ttf)
      Copyright 2014 The Source Serif 4 Project Authors (https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif)
  JetBrains Mono (JetBrainsMono*.ttf)
      Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors (https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
  Noto Color Emoji (NotoColorEmoji.ttf)
      Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji)
